tests.name: 5 m sprint
tests.trialsRest: 2 familiarization + 3 timed trials; best valid trial
tests.standardization: Stable hard surface/turf; same footwear; same start; camera perpendicular/known scale
tests.primaryOutcomes: Time, peak acceleration proxy, first-3-step velocity curve
tests.poseFeatures: Trunk projection, shin angle, hip projection, step symmetry
tests.caveat: Short split is sensitive to start and timing error; never compare hand-timed with automated/video protocols.

tests.name: 10 m sprint
tests.standardization: Same as T01; record 0-5 and 5-10 splits if possible
tests.primaryOutcomes: 10 m time, acceleration curve, split ratio
tests.poseFeatures: Knee drive, foot strike relative to COM, arm action
tests.caveat: Use full recovery; slow times under fatigue are not a pure speed measure.

tests.name: 20 m sprint
tests.standardization: Standardize start, surface, wind and device
tests.primaryOutcomes: 20 m time, 10-20 split, estimated top speed
tests.poseFeatures: Front-side mechanics, pelvis/trunk control, stride rhythm
tests.caveat: Top speed may not be reached, especially in older athletes.

tests.name: Flying 10/20 m
tests.trialsRest: 20-30 m build-in + timed 10 or 20 m; 2-3 trials
tests.standardization: Long safe run-off; consistent build-in and timing
tests.poseFeatures: Upright posture, step-down under COM, stiffness proxies
tests.caveat: Advanced test; not needed for young beginners.

tests.name: Countermovement jump
tests.trialsRest: 3-5 trials; hands fixed or free, but never mix protocols
tests.standardization: Calibrated camera; whole body visible; consistent countermovement instruction
tests.primaryOutcomes: Jump height, takeoff velocity proxy, flight time
tests.poseFeatures: Countermovement depth, extension sequence, landing symmetry
tests.caveat: Flight-time height is biased if takeoff and landing posture differ.

tests.name: Jump-and-stick quality
tests.standardization: Low-risk surface; no maximal box height
tests.caveat: Quality screen, not injury prediction or diagnosis.

tests.name: Standing broad jump
tests.trialsRest: 3 trials; toe line to nearest heel
tests.poseFeatures: Hip projection, arm swing, landing control
tests.caveat: Record invalid backward step separately; do not average invalid trials.

tests.name: Single-leg hop
tests.standardization: Same order or randomized; hands rule fixed
tests.caveat: Asymmetry is a monitoring flag, not a standalone injury prediction.

tests.name: 5-0-5 COD
tests.trialsRest: 3 trials each turning leg after familiarization
tests.standardization: Timing gates/video; foot must contact/clear turn line
tests.primaryOutcomes: Approach, turn and exit time; COD deficit
tests.poseFeatures: Penultimate braking, COM lowering, plant angle, reacceleration
tests.caveat: Report each side; do not hide asymmetry inside total time.

tests.name: 5-10-5 shuttle
tests.caveat: Retain if already in product, but 505 is cleaner for side-specific interpretation.

tests.name: Reactive Y agility
tests.standardization: Cue appears after approach trigger; log cue latency
tests.caveat: Do not label a pre-planned cone test as agility; true agility includes a stimulus.

tests.name: Cone slalom dribble
tests.standardization: Fixed cone count/spacing, ball size, start and finish
tests.poseFeatures: COM/ball relation, head position, contact distance
tests.caveat: Time alone rewards risky loss of control; score errors and retained control.

tests.name: Straight speed dribble
tests.primaryOutcomes: Time, ball-speed proxy, speed cost vs sprint
tests.caveat: Use speed cost = dribble time relative to matched sprint, not pooled raw time alone.

tests.name: Figure-8 dribble
tests.trialsRest: Timed 20-30 s or fixed laps; 2-3 trials
tests.caveat: Reliability depends on standardized cone spacing and error penalties.

tests.name: Passing gate accuracy
tests.trialsRest: 20 passes: left/right, fixed distance, fixed target width
tests.standardization: Same ball feed, target and surface
tests.primaryOutcomes: Hits, miss distance, ball speed if available
tests.caveat: Do not infer game passing quality from unopposed accuracy alone.

tests.name: First-touch into target
tests.primaryOutcomes: Target success, touch distance, next-action time
tests.poseFeatures: Scanning event, body orientation, first-contact surface
tests.caveat: Use a reliable ball feeder or record feed variability.

tests.name: Static shot speed + accuracy
tests.trialsRest: 6-10 shots each tested foot; separate speed and accuracy objectives
tests.standardization: Same ball, distance, run-up, target zones
tests.primaryOutcomes: Ball speed, target error, valid-contact rate
tests.poseFeatures: Plant position, trunk lean, hip rotation, follow-through
tests.caveat: Single-shot accuracy is noisy; report distribution and valid-trial count.

tests.name: Moving-ball finish
tests.standardization: Standard feed lane and target scoring
tests.caveat: Keep feed and pressure condition in the benchmark key.
